empty.title: No loans yet
empty.body: When you lend someone money, log it here and follow every repayment until it's paid back.

detail.cantDelete: Can't be deleted: it has repayments and their history would be lost.
detail.reminderText: Hi {{name}}, a friendly reminder of the pending balance of {{amount}}. Thanks!
detail.reminderHelp: We couldn't use the clipboard. Select the text and copy it.

history.title: Repayments
history.emptyBody: Every payment you receive will show up here.
history.deleteTitle: Delete the {{amount}} repayment from {{date}}? That amount becomes pending again.
history.deleteError: Couldn't delete the repayment. Try again.

form.amountRepaidHelp: {{amount}} already repaid: the amount can't go below that.
form.dueDateHelp: Once set, it can be changed but not removed.
form.accountEditHelp: Moves the loan transaction to this account. Repayments already logged stay in the account they went into.
form.createHelp: It's logged as a loan transaction: it comes out of the chosen account's balance, but it isn't spending and doesn't change your money available to spend.
form.saveError: Couldn't save. Check the details and try again.
form.saveValidationError: Check the details: the amount can't be less than what was already repaid, and the loan date can't be after the first repayment.

errors.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero
errors.dateFuture: The date can't be in the future
errors.dueBeforeLoan: The due date can't be before the loan
errors.amountBelowRepaid: It can't be less than what was already repaid ({{amount}})
errors.dateAfterRepayment: It can't be after the first repayment ({{date}})

repayment.title: Log repayment
repayment.help: It adds to the loan's account balance. It isn't income and doesn't change your money available to spend.
repayment.saveError: Couldn't save the repayment. Try again.

errors.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero
errors.amountTooHigh: Can't be more than what's left ({{max}})
errors.dateFuture: The date can't be in the future

delete.title: Delete loan
delete.body: The loan to “{{name}}” for {{amount}} will be deleted, with its loan transaction.
